title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
authors: J. Yang, C. Jimenez, A. Wettig, et al. (7 authors)
before: Agents were given raw shell access and expected to cope.
problem: Interfaces built for humans are poor interfaces for models, which have no screen and limited context.
breakthrough: Design the interface for the agent: scoped file viewing, guarded edits with linting, and concise feedback.
why: It showed a large share of agent performance comes from interface design rather than model capability.
next: The agent-computer interface idea runs through every serious coding agent since.
inherits: Tool design as a first-class part of agent engineering.
